liveOnly: Showing live workspaces. Start or update hyprmoncfg to include empty assigned workspaces.
setup.missing: Install the hyprmoncfg panel for workspace and display settings. It also guides you through installing hyprmoncfg if needed.
setup.disabled: Enable the hyprmoncfg panel to configure workspaces and finish setup.
setup.outdated: Update the hyprmoncfg panel to use the workspace planner and its setup controls.
setup.unavailable: Open hyprmoncfg to finish setup, then reopen this picker.
setup.unknown: Could not check the hyprmoncfg panel. Try again.
